hook: Simulation testing isn't just for distributed databases

beats.say: Deterministic simulation testing is usually seen as a tool for distributed systems. This essay argues every application can use it.
It starts with why we test: reactively, to pin down bugs users find, and defensively, to remove the doubt that slows every change.

Running your app inside a seedable, deterministic simulation of its environment makes failures reproducible and covers far more cases than hand-written tests. The author's point: this works for any kind of software, not just databases.
